h1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single high-pay food symbol for an original adult American diner themed slot game called Pickle Panic. Primary request: one exuberant overloaded cheeseburger served on a cream enamel diner plate, with THREE extremely large whole dill pickles sticking diagonally out of the burger, visibly more important than the burger. No characters or faces. Style/medium: hand inked American comic illustration, bold irregular dark contour lines at least 2 percent of canvas width, contours twice interior weight, solid black spot shadows, flat opaque ink fills, hard cel shading, at most three values per form, big chunky readable silhouettes, sparse interior detail. Palette: pickle green #6A9F35, dark olive #31572C, cream #FFF0CF, mustard yellow #E9B83E, tomato red #C84A36, black ink #20231D. Transparent canvas. One centered isolated symbol fills 80 percent of a square canvas, 10 percent clear padding all sides; broad pickle-heavy triangular silhouette, readable at 70px. Pickle skin has only three to five large bumps per pickle, no fine textures. The plate only has a bold clean rim, no thin filigree. Avoid: 3D, CGI, glossy highlights, gradients, airbrush, metallic shimmer, bloom, particles, depth of field, microtexture, halftone dots, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark. True transparent background.
wild: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Wild symbol style test for an original American pickle diner game. Draw a close-up portrait emblem of an anthropomorphic dill pickle short-order cook: the HEAD ITSELF is the upper rounded end of a bumpy green cucumber, visibly a cucumber with a tall elongated vegetable silhouette, no human skin or human head, broad mischievous eyes, thick crooked eyebrows, smug wide sideways grin, a white folded paper diner cap tilted back, tiny red neckerchief visible below. This is a third minor diner cook, not either board-side main cast. No hands, no body, no food platter, no labels. Place portrait inside a chunky cream jagged starburst badge with a bold black outer edge, a red inner ring only. Transparent canvas. One centered emblem with at least 8 percent blank margin. Style: hand-inked bold American comic, large solid ink shadows, thick irregular contour twice internal lines, flat opaque colors and clean hard-edged cel shadows, three values per form maximum, very few large skin bumps. Palette: #6A9F35 #31572C #FFF0CF #E9B83E #C84A36 #20231D. Crisp funny adult cartoon, not cute chibi. No gradients, no airbrush, no shiny realistic highlights, no 3D render, no microtexture, no halftone, no glow. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Genuine transparent background.
background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 gameplay background plate for original adult American pickle diner slot Pickle Panic. A bright 1950s roadside diner kitchen seen straight-on, handmade American comic ink drawing: cream enamel kitchen walls, large mustard-yellow pass-through service counter framing a quiet empty green backsplash occupying central 60 percent width, red-and-cream checker floor along bottom quarter, shelves of big squat pickle jars at outer left and right edges, vintage mustard squeeze bottle and diner coffee pot at far left, a red vinyl booth glimpse at far right. A few large pickles in the edge jars make the theme instantly recognizable. Reserve central area for a 5x4 reel grid: broad quiet muted cream and sage wall, no fine details in center. Reserve far right quarter for a full-body standing mascot, show quiet cream wall there. No people or characters, no anthropomorphic faces, no grid, no reels, no interface, no title, no letters or numbers, no labels on jars. Style: bold hand-inked American comic, thick irregular dark contours twice interior weight, large solid black spot shadows, flat opaque colors, one hard-edged cel shade per surface, at most three values per object, coarse sparse detail. Palette locked to cream #FFF0CF, pale sage #D5DFB5, pickle green #6A9F35, dark olive #31572C, mustard #E9B83E, tomato red #C84A36, ink #20231D. Background quieter and paler than foreground symbols. Daytime bright diffuse light expressed in hard color blocks. This is a sunny adult satire diner, not a grim scene or cute toy. Avoid 3D, CGI, realistic metal reflections, gradients, airbrush, shiny highlights, bloom, neon, particles, microtexture, fake paper noise, halftone dots, text, logo, watermark.
mg: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-body standing MG cast style test for an original American pickle diner slot Pickle Panic, compatible with our own segmented standing animation rig. Draw ONE anthropomorphic dill pickle diner owner, a tall chunky green bumpy PICKLE IS HIS ENTIRE HEAD AND TORSO, one continuous elongated cucumber silhouette from rounded crown to waist. Absolutely no human face, no human skin, no separate spherical head. Expressive squinting cream cartoon eyes and wide grumpy sideways smile near top of pickle, large crooked dark eyebrows, a small dark mustache of two ink wedges below the cucumber nose. Wears a small cream folded diner paper cap on top, a short cream waist apron tied below his large bare green pickle torso, red neckerchief around upper cucumber, a little loose apron bow hanging at his left hip. Two stout GREEN arms sprout from cucumber sides, separate from torso, hanging naturally with elbows slightly bent and relaxed three-finger GREEN hands, fists not touching body. Both whole forearms and fingers visible, >=6 percent canvas width air gap from torso. Two short sturdy GREEN legs below pickle, cream white socks and big mustard work shoes, feet planted at same baseline. No trousers that disguise vegetable body. Standing upright, chest angled subtly toward image LEFT because character will stand to right of reel board, eyes and face looking left. No props held, no pocketed hands, no crossed arms. Fully visible from cap to soles, centered on portrait 1:2 canvas, figure fits 84 percent height, at least 6 percent clear margin each side and 8 percent above/below. Keep arms separated from torso, both shoes and full hands visible for rigging, no detached parts, no extra characters. Original adult American comic cartoon, bold hand-inked dark contours twice interior line weight, solid black spot shadows, flat opaque color fills, no gradients, hard cel shadows, at most 3 values per form, sparse 6-8 large cucumber bumps, chunky readable forms, not chibi or baby. Palette #6A9F35 pickle green, #31572C olive shade, #FFF0CF cream, #E9B83E mustard, #C84A36 tomato red, #20231D ink. No 3D, realistic glossy highlight, bloom, halftone dots, fine texture, text, letters, numbers, logo or watermark. Genuine transparent background.
